title: Landing readiness check
description: Before anything lands or waits, the merge asks every landing question at once: review stage, close-out evidence flags, lane, checkout, stale lane, work claim, uncommitted lane files, blocking QA proof, the post-deploy QA answer, and the landing route's own gates: integration dependencies, candidate review, the merge-queue probe and, for a local landing, the project's registered verification command or no-tests attestation. It refuses with every failing gate and its recovery in one message; `--check` prints the same report from the same code and changes nothing. An item one declared edge before its review stage is not a blocker: the merge moves it into review, running that stage's gates, with `--verification` as the reason. QA proof on an older commit of the lane is not a blocker: the merge re-binds a passing hand verdict, or re-runs a method-backed case for the merging commit, including after that case failed on the older commit. Source-observed; not yet verified against a running Yoke.
